title: Beach Day
intro: [excited] Grab your sunscreen, your flip flops and your sense of humor, because this episode is a Beach Day! Twenty-six clues are washing ashore, so let's dive right in... before the tide goes out! [laughs]

art.prompt: A sunny tropical beach with turquoise waves, a carved outrigger canoe on white sand, palm trees, seashells, a striped umbrella and a glowing sunset sky, joyful summer vacation mood. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

categories.title: Making Waves with Moana
categories.intro: Our film category sets sail with Moana. Five clues about the girl who answered the call of the ocean. [mischievously] No wayfinding cheat sheets allowed!

art.prompt: An outrigger sailing canoe with a woven crab-claw sail gliding across a glowing turquoise ocean toward a lush green volcanic island, stars beginning to appear. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Moana's accidental stowaway on her voyage is Heihei, a hilariously clueless one of these birds
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a rooster. Heihei's squawks come from Alan Tudyk, who also voiced King Candy. [laughs] Zero brain cells, one hundred percent heart.

clues.clue: This shape-shifting demigod with a magical fishhook, voiced by Dwayne Johnson, stole the heart of Te Fiti
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Maui. [sarcastic] What can I say except... you're WELCOME! His animated tattoos, especially Mini Maui, were hand drawn by legendary Disney animator Eric Goldberg.

clues.clue: Moana is the daughter of the chief of this island, which she must leave to restore the heart of Te Fiti
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Motunui. Lalotai is the Realm of Monsters, and [whispers] trust me, you do NOT want to vacation there.

clues.clue: This giant, treasure-obsessed coconut crab sings 'Shiny' down in the Realm of Monsters
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tamatoa, voiced by Jemaine Clement of Flight of the Conchords. Fun fact: he'd rather be shiny, like a treasure from a sunken pirate wreck.

clues.clue: Lin-Manuel Miranda and Mark Mancina wrote Moana's songs with this frontman of the Pacific band Te Vaka
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Opetaia Foa'i. He sings on We Know The Way, and his band Te Vaka performs on the soundtrack. [excited] Give yourself a BIG pat on the back if you knew that one!

categories.title: Shell Yeah!
categories.intro: Time to meet the locals. These clues are all about the critters who live under the sea in Disney and Pixar films. [laughs] Shell yeah!

art.prompt: A vibrant coral reef teeming with colorful tropical fish, sea turtles, crabs and anemones, sunbeams streaming down through clear blue water. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Sebastian, King Triton's court composer in The Little Mermaid, is this kind of sea creature
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a crab. And if you guessed lobster, Sebastian would like a word. [chuckles] Probably a very long, very Jamaican word.

clues.clue: In Finding Nemo, this laid-back 150-year-old sea turtle rides the East Australian Current
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Crush, totally voiced by director Andrew Stanton himself. [excited] Righteous! Grab some shell, dude.

clues.clue: This know-it-all seagull tells Ariel that a fork is called a 'dinglehopper'
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Scuttle, voiced by Buddy Hackett. [chuckles] Fun fact: his snarfblatt, also known as a pipe, is apparently a musical instrument.

clues.clue: In Finding Dory, this grumpy octopus who is missing a tentacle gets called a 'septopus'
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hank. He reportedly took Pixar about two years to build, so give him a round of applause. All seven arms worth.

clues.clue: Ariel has six older sisters. Which of these names does NOT belong to one of them?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Alexa. The real sisters are Aquata, Andrina, Arista, Attina, Adella and Alana. [laughs] King Triton REALLY committed to the letter A.

categories.title: Swimsuit Season
categories.intro: It's swimsuit season! I'll show you the colors of a character's signature look, and you tell me who's wearing them. [whispers] No peeking at the beach towels.

art.prompt: Colorful beach towels, swimsuits and flip flops laid out on bright sand like a painter's palette of swatches, seen from above. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Sea-green fin, a lilac seashell top and bright red hair. Who's ready for a swim?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ariel. Fun fact: her shade of red hair needed its own custom paint color, named Ariel.

clues.clue: Fuzzy blue fur, a lighter blue tummy, big dark eyes and pink inside those huge ears.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Stitch. Experiment 626 can't swim, so he's strictly a sand castle guy on beach day. [chuckles]

clues.clue: A red-orange woven top, a tan leafy skirt, a shell necklace and long dark curls.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Moana. Her necklace holds the heart of Te Fiti, so please... don't lose it in the sand.

clues.clue: Lavender skin, a black strapless gown, white swept-up hair and bold red lips.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ursula. Animators based her look partly on the drag performer Divine. [mischievously] Poor unfortunate souls who missed that one!

clues.clue: Snowy white hair, sun-kissed skin, blue face markings and a glowing blue crystal necklace.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Kida, princess of Atlantis. Her full name is Kidagakash. [laughs] Bonus points if you can spell that without looking!

categories.title: Surf's Up
categories.intro: Our Disney Parks category of the week is Surf's Up. Water parks, pools and sandy hideaways. [chuckles] Keep your arms and legs inside the lazy river at all times.

art.prompt: A cheerful resort water park with twisting water slides, a lazy river, a wave pool, and a shipwrecked shrimp boat perched on a rocky mountain top. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: This Walt Disney World water park is themed to a ski resort where all the snow melted
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Blizzard Beach. It's home to Summit Plummet, one of the tallest, fastest free-fall slides around. [excited] Brrr-illiant!

clues.clue: At Typhoon Lagoon, this shipwrecked shrimp boat sits atop Mount Mayday and blasts a geyser of water into the air
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Miss Tilly. Legend says a typhoon tossed her onto the mountain. [sighs] Talk about a rough day at the office.

media.prompt: A battered wooden shrimp boat impaled on top of a rocky tropical mountain, spraying a tall geyser of water into the sky above a wave pool full of swimmers. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Opened in 1998, this was the first private island in the Bahamas for Disney Cruise Line guests
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Castaway Cay. And yes, Cay is pronounced key, so STOP saying 'Castaway Kay' at dinner parties. [laughs]

clues.clue: This Disney resort and spa on Oahu's Ko Olina coast opened in 2011
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Aulani. Its name roughly means a messenger of a chief in Hawaiian, and it has its own lazy river called Waikolohe Stream.

clues.clue: Shared by Disney's Yacht Club and Beach Club, this three-acre pool area has a sandy bottom and a shipwreck slide
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Stormalong Bay, named after the legendary giant sailor Alfred Bulltop Stormalong. [excited] Sand-bottom pools... all the beach, none of the seagulls.

categories.title: Rhyme Tide
categories.intro: Our fan category is Rhyme Tide. Every answer is a rhyming pair with an ocean-going Disney twist. Get your best poet hat on. Or a sun hat. [chuckles] Either works.

art.prompt: Message in a bottle washing ashore with poetry-like waves of sea foam, seashells and starfish arranged in pairs along the tide line. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: A bedtime tale all about Finding Nemo's forgetful blue tang
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a Dory Story. [singing] Just keep reading, just keep reading... [dramatic pause] Wait, what were we doing?

clues.clue: A little bus that drives The Little Mermaid's know-it-all seagull around
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Scuttle Shuttle. [laughs] Next stop, the dinglehopper store.

clues.clue: A big hurry made by Finding Nemo's surfer-dude sea turtle
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a Crush Rush. Totally gnarly traffic out on the East Australian Current today, dudes.

clues.clue: An invoice from the scarred Moorish idol who leads the Tank Gang
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a Gill Bill. [chuckles] Payment accepted in pebbles... and escape plans.

clues.clue: A brand-new T-shirt for Crush's little son
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a Squirt Shirt. Squirt was voiced by Nicholas Bird, the son of Pixar director Brad Bird. [excited] Jellyman, offspring, offspring, jellyman!
